cohort: 2194 women with twin pregnancies not complicated with very low birthweight
finding: The rate of vaginal delivery among women with twin pregnancies who undergo labor can be high, especially in women who labored spontaneously and have delivered before.
mod_finding: Nulliparity, Foley induction of labor, and a BMI > 30 kg/m² were independent risk factors for cesarean delivery in women with twin pregnancies.
